summary: Beautiful puzzles to tickle your brain cells!
description: Travel through the universe where space-time is fractured into just 1s and 3s. Download and have fun exploring this strange universe, filled with black holes, wormholes, and whatnot. GAMEPLAY EXPERIENCE 🚀 Beautiful and challenging hand-crafted puzzles 🚀 Interesting perks to play with, such as the ability to control time, filter out mirages, and perhaps more 🚀 Seamless gameplay experience with no ads or in-app purchases 🚀 No restarts, or game over prompts. Just rewind time and start over 🚀 Play online or offline 🚀 Soothing music STORY The fever of space exploration only raised since the 23rd century, and now in the year 2620, we witness a new danger in front of Earthlings. Each planet they own, they overexploit in their greed, and soon there will be nothing left. They promised us the golden future. They said we will reach the stars. When the first rocket was launched – we cheered. No one could ever know the consequences of what will happen. We didn't expect the tensions and race, but they happened. Even in a time of peace, they never finished. We soon became the biggest space colonizer. However, everything has its' cost, and soon resources were gone. It became a time for a new adventurer to set foot on an unknown path… Music 🎵 Alexander Nyman 🎵 Kevin MacLeod Featuring Music by Matthew Pablo http://www.matthewpablo.com
